ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation field with localized high-contrast white annular blobs (3-10 pixel diameters) distributed across both lobes, with higher densities at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped notch with an approximate 35-degree vertex angle and significant depth relative to the fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous small-scale serrations with an average amplitude of 5 pixels and high frequency along the trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory observed from the median notch to the outer tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely scattered circular and ring-like white clusters (rosettes) across the entire dark-pigmented fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Widespread circular barnacle attachment scars distributed across the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The circular scars predominantly exhibit an annular (ring-shaped) pixel distribution with darker centers.
